newsitem.title: USA: Converse sales up in January, February.
newsitem.headline: Converse sales up in January, February.

text.p: Converse Inc said Monday its net sales were $74.4 million in the first two months of 1997, up 65 percent from a year earlier.
It reported substantial increases in each of its four core categories: basketball, athleisure, children's and cross training.
The company said it also improved its gross margin in January and February compared to the prior-year period.

The company's global backlog increased to a record high of $222.1 million at February 28, a 49 percent increase from $148.8 million a year earlier. Basketball was up 70 percent, athleisure 47 percent, children's 43 percent, and cross training 18 percent.
As a consequence of the increases in net sales and backlog, Converse said it believes net sales for the first quarter will be up about 50 percent from a year earlier.
